summary: ORQ-17 static/read-only auth and exposure audit completed. Publishing the raw loopback service is unsafe while local bypass makes anonymous browser API requests run as the owner. Exit gates require owner-approved HTTPS/ACL, real password session, anonymous /api/me=401, loopback backend/Postgres, same-origin proxy validation and one-command proxy rollback. Nine historical issues remain preserved. Pre-token-only backups are known-bad and must not be used as rollback.
mutations: Only own evidence, durable report, and checkout protocol files; no code/live/board/credential mutation.
